name: MonElu
description: MonÉlu is a civic transparency platform that makes the voting record of every deputy in the French Assemblée Nationale fully accessible

paragraphs: MonÉlu is a civic transparency platform that makes the voting record of every deputy in the French Assemblée Nationale fully accessible — in plain language, in real time. Built for journalists, researchers, and engaged citizens who shouldn't need to dig through government ZIP exports to understand how their representatives vote.
